title: AI-assisted Artifact Collaboration Workflow
summary: 研究 Dropbox、Conversation、Primary Agent local workspace 與 GitHub 的低摩擦 Artifact Collaboration Workflow。已驗證同一套 Batch-first publication contract 同時支援 1 張與多張圖片：Primary 處理並放入 Dropbox staging，建立 temporary URLs 與 batch_json；Claire 每批只需按一次 GitHub Actions Run；Runner 一次抓取整批、逐項驗 bytes/SHA-256/full decode，全部成功才一次 commit。主要剩餘缺口是 Primary 缺 autonomous workflow_dispatch write primitive。
flow: Verified major path: 1 image = 1-item batch; N images = N-item batch; one Human Run per batch. Conversation/local processing → Dropbox staging → temporary URLs → GitHub Runner batch ingest → per-item integrity verification → atomic publication → one commit. Remaining main gap: Primary cannot autonomously workflow_dispatch with current GitHub Connector.
